name: Watch Olo Network (second-party 0% commission) + Menusso

gap: Watch only — Olo is enterprise/chain-skewed; skip any labor modules
summary: Olo Network is a material second-party KEEP peer to track; Menusso is another branded-app zero-commission watch.
